item.title: JPMorgan Eyes Big Discount to Get Software Debt Off Banks’ Books
item.description: Banks led by JPMorgan Chase & Co. could offer one of the year’s biggest discounts to sell some of the $5 billion in debt for software firm Qualtrics International Inc. that the underwriters were stuck holding a few months ago.

item.title: Fed Needs to Raise Rates at Least Two More Times, Logan Says
item.description: "It remains clear to me, given the current outlook, that the FOMC needs to implement at least two more 25-basis-point rate increases," Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas President Lorie Logan says during a conference in Houston. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bucks President on Building Beyond Giannis
item.description: Can the Milwaukee Bucks stay compelling beyond a superstar? President Josh Glessing joins Bloomberg Open Interest to discuss building for the future, rising sports-team valuations, institutional investment and how fragmented broadcasts can still deliver value to fans. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Stocks Slide on Calls for Rate Hikes After Hot Inflation Report
item.description: US equities extended losses Tuesday as Federal Reserve officials called for rate hikes in the wake of hotter-than-expected inflation data.

item.title: Tribunal Finds Emerge Canada Mismanaged Cathie Wood-Linked ETFs
item.description: The failed investment firm that sold Toronto-listed versions of Cathie Wood’s exchange-traded funds took self-dealing loans, maintained improper records and failed to act in the best interest of its funds, Canada’s top securities regulator ruled.
